en: Allow different conversations to run concurrently in the same or overlapping working directories, including tasks with write access.
Keep message ordering within each conversation and isolate stop, approval and live guidance by conversation.
zh: 取消工作目录排队限制：不同会话在相同或重叠目录下均可同时执行，包括具有写入权限的会话。
保留同一会话内的消息顺序，停止、审批和实时引导仍按会话隔离。
